يتناسيان (form VI)
# يَتَنَاسَيَانِ (yatanāsayāni) /ja.ta.naː.sa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
# يُتَنَاسَيَانِ (yutanāsayāni) /ju.ta.naː.sa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
